name: Goading Ammunition

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: A creature it damages makes a DC 13 Charisma save or can't take Reactions until its next turn; then it's ordinary.
text: A creature damaged by this ammunition makes a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. The ammunition then loses its magic.
